name: Rewrite a LinkedIn profile
when: The founder wants their LinkedIn headline, About section or Featured items to match what they do now.
procedure: Ask for the current headline, About and Featured, and the goal: customers, hiring or authority.
Headline, up to 220 characters: what you do | who you help | the result, with a real number if the founder has one.
About, 200 to 300 words, first person ("I help"): hook with a number, what you do and for whom, one or two wins, how you solve it, one human line, keywords, next step.
Check the first 265 characters of About alone: they must carry the pitch, because the rest hides behind "see more".
Featured: three items matched to the goal, e.g. a case study and a booking link for customers.
Show before and after for each part. The founder edits the profile by hand.
pitfalls: Third person ("Jane is a passionate…") and words like passionate, driven, results-oriented, thought leader read as filler.
A win without a number is a claim; ask for the number or leave the win out.
verify: The headline is at most 220 characters in the what | who | result shape, About is 200 to 300 words in first person with the pitch inside its first 265 characters, and every number came from the founder.
